policy_summary: The current official fair-data-usage policy addresses commercial, AI-usage and model-training permission requests and says users making such requests should assume no data-use permission is granted. Free CSV/Excel data are intended for private personal betting and/or academic interest/research via manual download or at most light (twice-weekly maximum) automated download; this does not establish permission for MARKET_ANCHOR_1X2_V2 AI source collection or inference.
